messages:
inc-bot: INCIDENT: KV cache footprint spike + continuous-batching surge in us-west-2. Paging oncall. Detected 03:12 UTC. Symptoms: per-request KV size growth, paging/evictions, p95 latency ~3x, error rate ~4.8% across hosted endpoints. Root cause suspected: recent quantization/kernel path change for AWQ/INT8 variants. 

elena: Ack — oncall here. Marking priority=P0. Which model routes are hot? Any customer-facing 5xxs yet?

inc-bot: Top affected routes: /models/gpt-large-awq-v1 (awq-int8), /models/gptq-6b-int8. Metrics snapshot (03:14 UTC):
```
kv_cache_total_bytes: 5.8e7
avg_kv_per_request_bytes: 6.1e7  # baseline ~1e7
evictions_last_5m: 342
paging_events: 78
p95_latency_ms: 1120  # baseline ~380
error_rate_pct: 4.8
```
Reported by infra alerts: cont-batch window lengths increased 2.7x after yesterday's runtime rollout (rtm-2026-0314-04).

marko: I rolled the AWQ int8 kernel switch early today (rtm change). Hypothesis: the new 'fast-kv' kernel trades compute for larger KV layout (packed tables) which increases per-request KV size on longer sequences. It interacts poorly with continuous batching because more requests keep KV alive longer -> snowball. Recommend immediate mitigations:
- rollback kernel to compat/compact-kv for affected routes
- reduce batch sizing (max_batch_tokens and batch_timeout) to shorten windows
- increase kv eviction aggressiveness (lower thresholds)

sophie: Agreed. Preparing a throttled hotfix: set batch.max_tokens=1024 (was 4096), batch.timeout_ms=8 (was 16), kv.eviction_threshold=0.45 (was 0.7). Applying to us-west-2 hot pool first.

elena: Can we rollback kernel for only the AWQ INT8 variant and leave fp16 paths intact? We want minimal blast radius. Also need a quick customer impact summary for ops.

marko: Yes, we can pin kernel per-route. Command I will run (control plane):
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/routes/configure \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"route":"/models/gpt-large-awq-v1","kernel":"compat-kv","batch.max_tokens":1024,"batch.timeout_ms":8,"kv.eviction_threshold":0.45}'
```

sophie: Applying batch throttle + kv eviction now to pool us-west-2-hot (canary 10% nodes)

deploy-bot: deploy started: rtm-hotfix-2076543210-1 -> applying config to 10% canary nodes. CI checks passed.

sophie: Canary metrics 2m after hotfix:
```
canary_kv_avg_bytes: 1.8e7
canary_evictions_5m: 48
canary_p95_ms: 420
canary_error_rate_pct: 1.1
```
Looks promising. Rolling to remaining nodes in 5m if stable.

elena: Noted. Dinesh, any customers flagged by support? Need to surface to CS and send targeted status.

dinesh: Two paying customers reported latency/502s in the last 10m (Acct A, Acct B). Both on heavy prompt lengths >2k tokens on int8 variants. Sending immediate status note and offering short-term mitigation: pin them to fp16 variant until full rollback.

marko: Starting kernel pin rollback for AWQ int8 routes across region (non-disruptive). Commands:
```
# region-wide rollout (non-restart)
controlplanectl set route /models/gpt-large-awq-v1 kernel=compat-kv --region us-west-2 --strategy gradual
```

inc-bot: alert: paging_events dropping, eviction queue length decreasing. Keep watching.

sophie: Rolling to 100% now. tail of server logs shows eviction reductions and batch window shortening. Snippet: 
```
[03:25:12] runtime: batch_window_ms=7.9 -> 7.0
[03:25:13] kv_cache_size=18721KB evictions=51
[03:25:40] p95_latency_ms=410
[03:26:01] errors_5xx=0.6%
```

elena: Great. Summarize mitigations and next steps for the postmortem:
- Immediate: batch throttling (max_tokens->1024), batch.timeout_ms->8, kv.eviction_threshold->0.45 applied to us-west-2; kernel pinned to compat-kv for AWQ int8 routes; customer workarounds: pin to fp16 variants for affected accounts.
- Monitoring: lower alert thresholds for kv per-request and cont-batch window length; add histogram of kv_bytes/request.
- Engineering follow-up: regression test for kernel change on kv footprint across sequence-length distributions; canary policy requiring kv size sanity check for kernel swaps.

dinesh: I'll draft the customer impact email. Notifying top 3 affected accounts now.

marko: Opening an internal ticket (RD-INC-207654) to track root cause, include kernel commit rtm-2026-0314-04 and telemetry. Add perf tests for awq/int8/gptq variants across 128/512/2048 seq lengths.

sophie: Handoff to night oncall @marko — keep an eye on any regression when full traffic hits. Alerts lowered to p95>600ms and kv_avg_bytes>3e7.

elena: Thanks all. Current status: mitigations applied, stability improving. Leaving thread open for postmortem drafting. If things spike again, escalate to ENG-ML and Infra. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: deploy finished: rtm-hotfix-2076543210-1 -> success (full rollout completed at 03:32 UTC).

inc-bot: metrics stable 03:34 UTC snapshot: p95_latency_ms=395, error_rate_pct=0.8, avg_kv_per_request=1.9e7, evictions_5m=40.

elena: Closing active page — will convert to postmortem ticket and schedule a root-cause review. Thanks team.
